## 2. Detailed Service Specifications

### 2.1 Custom Web & Full-Stack Software Development
- **Focus**: Eliminating heavy render bottlenecks, ensuring sub-second Time to First Byte (TTFB), and achieving perfect Google Lighthouse scores.
- **Tech Stack**: Modern JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, RESTful & GraphQL APIs, Node.js, and serverless hosting infrastructures (Vercel, Firebase).
- **Deliverables**: Enterprise web portals, SaaS platforms, corporate portfolio systems, dynamic clinic patient booking portals, and interactive product catalogs.

### 2.2 Mobile Application Development
- **Focus**: Smooth 60fps animations, cross-platform codebases, and offline-first capabilities.
- **Platforms**: Android and iOS via React Native and modern native bridges.
- **Use Cases**: E-commerce retail apps, clinic/patient appointment tools, educational student portals, and business operations apps.

### 2.3 Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- **Technical SEO**: Core Web Vitals optimization, semantic HTML5 hierarchy, JSON-LD Schema structured data, crawl budget maximization, canonicalization, and XML sitemaps.
- **Local SEO**: Google Business Profile (GBP) claimed verification, local pack top-3 ranking optimization, NAP (Name, Address, Phone) consistency, and neighborhood-specific keyword targeting.
- **Content SEO**: Long-tail search discovery, educational pillar content, and medical/educational compliance copywriting.

### 2.4 Meta Ads & Meta Business Profile Management
- **Focus**: High-ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) customer acquisition for consumer and healthcare/education sectors.
- **Capabilities**: Meta Business Suite verification, Meta Pixel & Conversions API (CAPI) implementation, ad creative production, copy testing, custom audience retargeting, and lookalike modeling.

### 2.5 Brand Identity & Visual Design
- **Deliverables**: Vector logos (SVG, PNG, print-ready formats), brand style guides, corporate typography selections, color contrast standards, stationery kits, and social media media kits.

### 2.6 Advanced Special Request Solutions
- **Cloud Architecture & DevOps**: Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipeline automation, and multi-region deployment strategies.
- **Cybersecurity Assessments**: Vulnerability checks, HTTPS and CSP compliance auditing, and secure authentication flow architecture.
- **AI Integrations**: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistants, custom AI API connectors, and automated workflows.
